_about: Incident types Primesight briefs on. category picks the skill (/playbook/skills/<category>/SKILL.md) and the draft's lead lines. keywords classify a dispatch text (first match wins, so specific types come first). needs = what the crew needs first; layers = where Primesight finds it (costar, matterport, sam3, vexcel, hydrants, notes). Order follows common US fire/EMS dispatch determinants (NFPA 1221 call types, EMD protocols), simplified.

types.label: Active threat / shooter
types.needs: how many people on the floor and nearby, exits and walk distances, out-of-sight staging, who has building access

types.label: Bomb threat / suspicious package
types.needs: building population for evacuation, staging distance, open lots away from glass

types.label: Person in crisis on roof or ledge
types.needs: roof access and roof type, stories, open ground below for an air cushion

types.label: Explosion
types.needs: construction type, people above and on the floor, tenant chemicals, hydrants

types.label: Natural gas odor / leak
types.needs: who is on the floor, tenant industries, utility shutoff unknown, staging upwind

types.label: Carbon monoxide alarm
types.needs: people on the floor, parking levels and mechanical rooms (CO sources), elevators

types.label: Chemical spill / hazmat release
types.needs: tenant industries (labs, medical, cleaning, manufacturing), floors above and below, hydrants for decon

types.label: Refrigerant / ammonia leak
types.needs: roof AC units (Vexcel), mechanical floors, people on the top floors

types.label: Elevator entrapment
types.needs: elevator types and counts, stories, building engineer / property manager to bring keys

types.label: Vehicle into building
types.needs: ground-floor tenants and headcount, construction type and year, aerial of the frontage, staging

types.label: Structural collapse / person trapped
types.needs: construction frame, year built, people on the floor, floor layout from the scan

types.label: Stranded window washer / suspended worker
types.needs: stories, roof type and AC units, open ground for staging

types.label: Confined space rescue
types.needs: basement / mechanical / parking levels, building engineer, construction

types.label: Sprinkler water-flow alarm / flooding
types.needs: sprinkler type (wet/dry), floors below the leak, tenants with equipment, property manager

types.label: Power outage with people affected
types.needs: elevators (entrapment risk), stories, building engineer, people above

types.label: Rooftop / solar panel fire
types.needs: roof material, solar panels and rooftop units from aerial data, building height, hydrants, wind

types.label: Parking garage / vehicle fire
types.needs: whether the building has covered or attached parking and the parking elevators, people on floors above the garage, EV batteries (re-ignite, toxic smoke), wind for smoke drift, hydrants; clearance height and standpipe locations are NOT KNOWN unless a crew note gives them

types.label: Lithium battery / e-bike fire
types.needs: people on the floor and above, tenants that store batteries, sprinkler type, wind for toxic smoke drift

types.label: Electrical fire / smoking panel
types.needs: people on the floor and above, sprinkler type, building engineer

types.label: Working structure fire
types.needs: people above the fire floor, stairs and standpipes, sprinklers, hydrants, staging, roof

types.label: Commercial fire alarm activation
types.needs: which floor, people on it, pull stations and exits seen in the scan

types.label: Smoke investigation
types.needs: people above, sprinklers, exits and pull stations seen on the floor

types.label: Cardiac arrest
types.needs: elevator for a stretcher, the suite on the floor, AED location (usually unknown), who meets the crew

types.label: Heat illness
types.needs: patient floor, stretcher-sized elevator, current temperature, building cooling unknown

types.label: Stroke
types.needs: elevator, suite, fastest route; time matters

types.label: Overdose / poisoning
types.needs: suite, elevator, tenant type (clinic, residence)

types.label: Difficulty breathing / allergic reaction
types.needs: elevator, suite, any air-quality cause on the floor

types.label: Fall / injury
types.needs: elevator, suite, stairs if no elevator

types.label: Multiple patients (MCI)
types.needs: floor population, staging and treatment area outside (open lots), elevators

types.label: Unconscious / fainting
types.needs: elevator, suite, who meets the crew

types.label: Unknown odor / fumes investigation
types.needs: tenant industries on and near the floor, people on the floor, wind direction, HVAC unknown

types.label: Medical emergency
types.needs: elevator, suite, who meets the crew
